VBO:0201284.summary: Determined and alert, the Sporting Lucas Terrier tends to bring a keen, independent approach to hunting while remaining responsive to direction. Its working role includes pushing game out of thick cover and pursuing ground vermin above and below ground. British breeders maintain this compact terrier primarily for that work.
VBO:0201284.shortDescription: A determined working terrier, keen to search thick cover and tackle ground vermin while responding to direction.

sources.title: United Kennel Club — Sporting Lucas Terrier standard
sources.evidence: Determined, alert, keen independent worker responsive to instruction; pushing game from thick cover and ground-vermin work above/below ground; maintained primarily as a working terrier in Great Britain. No ancient continuity or original-Lucas identity claimed.

VBO:0200661.summary: Outgoing, playful and curious, the modern Havana Silk Dog is bred to be a lively, confident companion. Initial reserve toward unfamiliar people is meant to give way to friendliness after an introduction, and it can serve as an alert dog. Selected from Havanese stock, this population formed its own association in 2007 and maintains a separate registry; its breeders preserve an athletic build and flat, silky coat.
VBO:0200661.shortDescription: An outgoing, playful companion from a separately registered Havanese-derived population, curious and inclined to give an alert.

sources.title: HSDAA — Havana Silk Dog standard
sources.evidence: Outgoing/playful/curious/lively/confident companion ideal, initial stranger reserve expected to resolve after introduction, alert role; athletic straight-legged flat single silky coat. All character stated as breeding aims.

sources.title: HSDAA — current registry scope
sources.evidence: Separate closed registry, non-interbreeding policy with American Havanese and recognition not requested from all-breed registries. No phenotype-only registration asserted.

sources.title: UC Davis Veterinary Genetics Laboratory — Havana Silk Dog report, introduction
sources.evidence: Introduction identifies Havanese-derived modern population, selection beginning2000 and formation of HSDAA2007. No medical claim, genetic superiority or independent breed-recognition claim.
